report.title: Option to hide the Tags section in the sidebar (hide display only, tag functionality unchanged)
report.body:
### Check before submitting

- [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate

### What problem would this solve?

In the current web UI the left sidebar offers two overlapping ways to narrow down the same memo list: the views/navigation entries at the top, and the "Tags" section below them. Both act as filters over the same feed, so for anyone with a lot of tags (dozens of tags, or nested/parent tags) the sidebar becomes long, repetitive, and requires scrolling, while the tag list adds little navigation value beyond what views and filters already provide.

Today there is no way to keep tags as data and keep filtering by tag, but stop the sidebar from listing every tag. The only workarounds are renaming or deleting tags, or collapsing the tag tree — the first loses information, the second does not really solve the clutter (the section still occupies space and still expands back).

Concretely: I browse mostly through views and search filters, and my tag cloud makes the sidebar hard to scan on a laptop screen and unusable on a small window.


### What would you like to happen?

Please add a user-level display option that hides the "Tags" section from the sidebar — for example a toggle under Settings, or a small hide/show (collapse) control in the "Tags" section header itself.

Requirements:

1. Purely presentational. Hiding the section must not disable tags anywhere else: inline #tag autocomplete while writing, tag colors, tag pages / tag detail routes, tag filtering in search and CEL filters, and the untagged filter should all keep working exactly as before.
2. Per-user and persisted. The preference should be stored per user (like the existing per-user tag colors and content-blur settings), so it affects only my own sidebar and survives reload / re-login.
3. Reversible. Easy to bring the section back without losing state.
4. Nice-to-have, same need: if a full hide is not desirable, a collapse control plus "show only pinned/top N tags" would also solve the clutter.

Searched existing issues first; the closest ones are #3238 (tag management / garbage-collecting unused tags) and #4686 (excluding specific tags in filters). Both are closed and neither covers "hide the Tags section while keeping tag functionality intact".


### Additional context

_No response_

plan.reported_actual: The sidebar always lists the Tags section, and there is no setting or control to hide it, which makes the sidebar long and cluttered for users with many tags.

Whether the preferred design is a Settings toggle or a collapse control in the Tags section header
Whether the 'show only pinned/top N tags' nice-to-have is in scope
